parameters.name: attachResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the attachment point.

parameters.name: attachResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of attachment point supported by the policy.

- HttpApi: HttpApi.
- Operation: Operation of HttpApi.
- GatewayRoute: gateway route.
- GatewayService: gateway service.
- GatewayServicePort: gateway service port.
- Domain: gateway domain name.
- Gateway: gateway.

parameters.name: withAttachments
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return attachment information.

parameters.name: withSystemPolicy
parameters.description: Specifies whether the policy is a system policy.
